thread:
sarah: Heads up — after yesterday's RBAC role-matrix refactor some editors can still call the project.delete API even though the UI button is hidden. Not sure if token scope issue or backend permission check dropped.

jamal: Can you paste repro steps? user id / route / sample token? Also is this in prod or staging?

sarah: Observed in prod. Steps: Project Settings -> Danger Zone -> Delete project button is greyed out for 'editor' but curl works:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/123/delete" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

maria: I rolled out a session expiry change last night (session ttl reduced & token refresh flow updated). Pushed commit 5f8b2ac to auth-service at 02:14 UTC. Could be a caching mismatch between permission cache and session cache.

akshay: We also rotated KMS alias for project keys as part of compliance work — KMS rotations returned 403 for ~3–5 minutes. Could that have caused auth-service fallback code to assume elevated perms?

jamal: If backend permission check was skipped, audit logs should show missing role-eval or missing project.delete events. sec-bot, any automated alerts?

sec-bot: Alert: 3 role-eval events failed to log between 2026-03-18T02:12:00Z and 2026-03-18T02:18:00Z. Trace IDs: trace-7a, trace-7b. (audit-service)

deploy-bot: Deployed auth-service 5f8b2ac to prod by maria at 2026-03-18T02:14:11Z

jamal: Sarah — can you share the user id & token expiry? Also grep audit logs for 'project.delete' requests around that time. If missing, we need to decide fail-open vs fail-closed and treat as incident.

sarah: User: emma@redwood.com, token exp 2026-03-18T02:17:30Z. I found a single POST to /projects/123/delete with 200 at 02:17:32Z but no corresponding audit log entry.

akshay: I'll check KMS rotation windows and key access logs. If auth-service couldn't reach KMS, it might have used a cached credential that skipped audit signature step.

jamal: Priority = P0 triage. If an action is allowed without an audit entry, that's a compliance incident. Let's open an incident and rollback the change if we can repro.

maria: On it. Reverting auth-service to 5f7a9d1 (pre-change) in 10 mins for canary. Will post canary results.

sarah: :thumbsup: I'll create a minimal repro script and add it here.

jamal: Also check console UI gating — frontend shows button disabled but server misalignment is worse. Add temporary guard on server side: reject project.delete unless role === "admin".

akshay: Agree. Adding hotfix: strict role check for delete. Patch pushed to auth-service hotfix branch, will flip feature flag 'rbac-strict-delete' for canary.

deploy-bot: Hotfix rolled to prod canary at 2026-03-18T02:40:02Z by akshay

sarah: Repro still works on old token but fails with new hotfix token. After hotfix canary, no delete allowed for editor. Will run integration tests and post results.

jamal: Next steps: run audit-service backfill for missing events, confirm KMS rotations didn't log errors, write incident doc in /incidents. I'll start the incident ticket.

sarah: Incident ticket INC-20260318-01 created, adding timeline + repro. tagging @maria @akshay
